Summary: God's command to Abraham: take Isaac, his only son, to Moriah and offer him as a burnt offering.
Commandment: Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
Application: The hardest one-time command in Genesis, completed by obedience and then stayed: the angel's counter-word, lay not thine hand upon the lad (Genesis 22:12), belongs to this same episode and is covered here rather than rowed as a second command. God provided the ram instead (Genesis 22:13).
Purpose: To test whether Abraham feared God and withheld nothing, even his promised son (Genesis 22:12 states the test's point after the stay).
